summary: An experimental eight-voice drone and polyphonic FM synth inspired by the SOMA Lyra-8, with separate DRONE and POLY modes. It has had only limited testing on hardware.
features: Eight voices as four interacting FM pairs
DRONE mode with latches and hold; chromatic 27-key POLY mode
Hyper LFO, dual modulated delay, distortion and compression
Arpeggiator at 10-400 BPM with programmable USER steps
Mutation with one-level undo; 16 factory presets, 8 user slots
POLY settings not stored in presets; flashing visuals in 2.0.1 only
